Package org.apache.wiki.tags

Class CalendarTag

java.lang.Object
jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.TagSupport
org.apache.wiki.tags.WikiTagBase
org.apache.wiki.tags.CalendarTag
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.IterationTag, jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.JspTag, jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.Tag, jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.TryCatchFinally, Serializable
public class CalendarTag extends WikiTagBase
Provides a nice calendar. Responds to the following HTTP parameters:
  • calendar.date - If this parameter exists, then the calendar date is taken from the month and year. The date must be in ddMMyy format.
  • weblog.startDate - If calendar.date parameter does not exist, we then check this date.
If neither calendar.date nor weblog.startDate parameters exist, then the calendar will default to the current month.
Since:
2.0

    • setPageformat

      public void setPageformat(String format)
      Sets the page format. If a page corresponding to the format is found when the calendar is being rendered, a link to that page is created. E.g. if the format is set to 'Main_blogentry_'ddMMyy, it works nicely in conjunction to the WeblogPlugin.
      Parameters:
      format - The format in the SimpleDateFormat fashion.
      See Also:

      • WeblogPlugin
